name: gamenet_are_all_players_at_lap_target
description: GameNet::AreAllPlayersAtLapTarget marks that the check has started and returns whether every network player row has reached the race lap target.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional and uses native list fixtures.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433200 validates setting g_GameNetAllPlayersLapTargetCheckStarted, iterating rows from g_GameNetPlayerRowHead, comparing row lapCount at offset 0x10 against g_HudSensorTracker.runtimeGoalValue, returning 0 for the first short row, and treating an empty list as complete.
The native GameNet smoke verifies complete, incomplete, and empty player-row list cases and the check-started flag side effect.
